card.name: Conditional and location linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as whenever, if, when, after, in, all and between that follow a verb or 'only' and open a condition, time or place phrase. Seen in both label text and general web text.

modes.label: Condition or time words
modes.description: Words like whenever, if, when and after that begin a condition or timing clause after a passive verb.
modes.example: may be expected only<< when>> recommended dosages are not exceeded and individual

modes.label: Place or scope words
modes.description: Words like in, all and between that begin a phrase saying where something is found or used.

card.plain: It fires on short linking words like when, if and in that start a condition or a place phrase.
